My dear [Cobweb](/person/675),
I should not have bothered you about your questions this month but that [Chelsea China](/person/329) told me that your [Mother](/person/1934) was so much better that she thought you would be able to do them or rather ask them- and as it is so we shall get the order of things right again.
I think the two [questions](/topic/104) that will make the most variety would be the history of the Knights’ [sic] Templars and the history of the Isle of Man. I am afraid this is a poorish [Barnacle](/periodical/89) but I hope the next will be better
your affectionate
Mother Goose


[^1]: Cream envelope 68mm x 122mm with stamped mark Parkins & Gotto, Makers 24 & 25, Oxford Street and remains of flower embossed wafer, addressed to Miss Helmore/ 6 Cheyne Walk/ Chelsea/ SW, and postmarked Winchester 29 April 1865 and London 1 May 1865.
